reason: ZKM runs Drupal 10 but JSON:API and core REST are both disabled (404, rewrapped as 404 HTML). The public collection IS fully scrapeable via HTML: a paginated listing at /en/collection?page=0..177 yields 4,087 unique /en/artworks/{slug} links, and each detail page exposes clean Drupal field--name-* markup (dt/dd pairs) — Title, Artist/Artist-group, Year (integer), Category (controlled vocab), Material/Technique, Dimensions/Duration. Original full-res images live at /system/files/field_media_image/{date}/{file} (un-derivative; verified 1024-1700px wide, ≥600px gate satisfied); the main work image is reliably identified as the file rendered in the img_node_media_detail image style (the img_node_media_teaser URLs are related-work thumbnails, not the work). Probe processed 15 candidates → 12 clean records uploaded to R2, R2 webp re-downloads at 200/1365x1024, zero markup leaks, all min-4 fields present, gray-print gate + 600px gate both fired correctly.

exhibitions_entry.name: ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe
exhibitions_entry.description: Founded in 1989 and housed since 1997 in a vast former munitions factory (the Hallenbau A), the ZKM in Karlsruhe is the world's foremost institution devoted to art in the age of digital media. It is unique among museums in uniting exhibition spaces with its own production and research laboratories, treating media art, video, computer-based and interactive work as a living, evolving practice. Its collection and archives document the history of the moving image and electronic art alongside contemporary painting, drawing, photography and prints.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 1989년 설립되어 1997년부터 옛 군수공장(Hallenbau A) 건물에 자리 잡은 카를스루에의 ZKM은 디지털 미디어 시대의 예술을 다루는 세계 최고의 기관이다. 전시 공간과 자체 제작·연구 실험실을 한데 묶어 미디어 아트와 비디오, 컴퓨터 기반·인터랙티브 작업을 끊임없이 진화하는 살아 있는 실천으로 다룬다는 점에서 여느 미술관과 구별된다. 소장품과 아카이브는 무빙 이미지와 전자예술의 역사를, 회화·드로잉·사진·판화 같은 동시대 평면 작업과 나란히 기록한다.

notes: FULL-RUN GUIDANCE: (1) Scope mix is media-art-heavy — across a 120-slug randomized sample: ~81% in-scope but only ~51% in-scope-WITH-image (~2,078 collectable of 4,087 nodes). Many in-scope works (esp. video) list a duration but carry no still image on the page; these are skipped (nothing to fetch). Category mix per sample: video 41, photograph 23, print 18, drawing 7, painting 7, mixed_media_2d 1. (2) Classifier treats compound ZKM categories correctly: EXCLUDE tokens win — 'Installation; Video' and 'Computer-based; Installation' are dropped as spatial/3D (a video INSTALLATION is not a flat screenable work), while pure 'Video'/'Film' stay in-scope as video; 'Painting; Drawing' → drawing. 'Artist Book', Sculpture, Object, Sound/Audio, Software/Net-art, Performance, Furniture/Design all excluded. (3) Gray-print gate (colorfulness<20) only applies to category=print (drawings/posters/photo/video never gated); expect ~30-60 monochrome reproductive prints removed → realistic final ~1,900-2,050 records, JSON ~2-3 MB (far under 24MB cap, no record cap needed). (4) Resume: scripts/.state/zkm-progress.json (per-slug done map + collected artworks), failures → scripts/.state/zkm-failed.ndjson, slug list cached in scripts/.state/zkm-slugs.json. (5) Run: node scripts/scrape-zkm.mjs --full  (~27 min, sequential detail scan + 4-way concurrent image pipeline at ~3.5 rps; browser-UA fallback on 403/429). (6) id scheme: 'zkm-{slug}' (globally unique, slug-based — no bare-integer collisions). R2 key: artworks/zkm-collection/{id}-{hash8}-imageUrl.webp. (7) Output written to public/data/zkm-collection.json with category_breakdown.
